_readme: Event highlights: the visual gallery on Community (#highlights). One object per photo or video; add one and it appears. Mix events freely: this is a board of Faith Works moments, not a list of one event. FIELDS: id · title (the event or moment, for screen readers and the overlay) · caption (a few words shown on the photo) · type ('photo' or 'video') · image (every item has one; for a video it's the poster: { base + widths } for responsive files, or a plain path string with imageAlt) · video (type 'video' only: path or URL of an .mp4, plays muted on hover/tap) · date (optional { day, month, year }) · url (optional: where the photo links, e.g. an album) · size ('large' 2×2 | 'wide' 2×1 | 'tall' 1×2 | 'regular' 1×1: the tile's shape on the 4-column board; sizes adding up to a multiple of 4 fill it evenly). Only caption what the photo actually shows.
